title: Hotend and Bed Temperature Stability
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=printer:telemetry
| eval hot_dev=abs(hotend_c-hotend_target), bed_dev=abs(bed_c-bed_target)
| stats max(hot_dev) as worst_hotend, max(bed_dev) as worst_bed by printer
| eval unstable=if(worst_hotend>5 OR worst_bed>5,1,0)
description: Tracks how tightly each printer holds its hotend and bed temperatures, since drift here causes layer defects and failed prints.
value: Temperature wobble is an early sign of a failing heater or thermistor; catching it prevents mid-print failures and bad layers.
implementation: Ingest firmware temperature telemetry; alert when the deviation from target exceeds a few degrees.
visualization: Time chart of temperature deviation from target per printer.
grandmaExplanation: It checks that the printer holds its heat steady, because temperature wobble causes bad prints.
